title: What do you think about sex scenes in the movies?

commenti.body:
No offense, but this sort of stream-of-consciousness schizo posting (or lazy attempt at shitposting/trolling) doesn't really contribute anything to this sub. 


There's *potentially* a point ot two to be made here about when and where sex scenes enhance a movie and when they detract from it, but you're making it in the most obnoxious and intellectually deficient way possible.
